sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Md. Fazle Karim, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner; Mr. Dilip Kumar No.1, learned APP for the State and Mr. Ashutosh Tripathy, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
2.

The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Sasaram Mufassil P.S. Case No. 56 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 307 and 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has filed a counter affidavit stating therein that the informant who is the wife of the petitioner is ready to live along with the petitioner.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.17211 of 2024(4) dt.13-09-2024 4.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that for better negotiation and amicable settlement between the parties, the matter be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation Tabis Quraishi @ Tavish Quraishi vs The State Of Bihar on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111850685/
1 Centre.
5.

sentences.text: As jointly agreed by the parties, they seek to tender their appearance before the learned Mediator at 04:30 P.M. on 24.09.2024.
6. The learned Mediator is directed to submit its report within a period of six months.

7. Re-notify the bail application after submission of the report by the learned Mediator.
